answer: Each identity is accepted only after a Wesolowski VDF proves the required chain of sequential modular squarings. Since each step depends on the previous result, GPUs cannot shorten that identity’s critical path through parallel execution. An attacker can run clone-specific chains on separate hardware, but must pay the same wall-clock delay and compute cost per clone; a kernel can verify proofs efficiently. A sonnet or saffron label changes no timing guarantee.
